Title: Multi-Class Road User Detection With 3+1D Radar in the View-of-Delft Dataset
Authors: Andras Palffy; Ewoud Pool; Srimannarayana Baratam; Julian F. P. Kooij; Dariu M. Gavrila
Sensor Modalities: Radar-only compared with LiDAR-only; VoD also includes camera
Core Method: Radar feature ablation and temporal accumulation
Input Features: x y z v_rel RCS; compensated radial velocity as decoration
Main Results: Radar 1 scan mAP 38.0; 3 scans 46.3; 5 scans 47.0; LiDAR 62.1; Driving Corridor Radar 5 scans 71.4; LiDAR 81.6
Contributions: VoD dataset; 3+1D radar baseline; Doppler RCS elevation and temporal ablations
Limitations: Sparse points; far-distance difficulty; occlusion and mounting differences; localization gap
Research Gap: Distance/RCS/sparsity-aware detection is a candidate question, NOT confirmed literature gap
Code Availability: 原论文实现基于 OpenPCDet；是否有可直接复现的官方代码/配置待核实
